title: Referral links, on a small scale
summary:
A small referral-link experiment was added to text responses, while two community-made image tools joined the project directory.

Referral-link processing was added for roughly 1% of eligible Markdown text responses. It can link up to three existing product or concept mentions, leaves plain text alone, and preserves the original response if processing fails. A new referral route records the visit topic before redirecting to pollinations.ai after three seconds.

The community directory gained Anime AI Generation, an anime character creator, and @hrisjeui’s AI Image Generator, which offers model choices, adjustable parameters, and a real-time preview. Both were added to the README and website listings.

OpenAI-format responses now receive newly generated IDs and creation timestamps instead of retaining provider metadata. The response helper also stopped filling in missing choice indexes and adding its previous cache header.
